description: Test suite for organization budget enforcement logic in the litellm proxy authentication module. Contains multiple async test cases that verify budget constraints at organization and team levels, including enforcement logic and error conditions.

classes.name: LiteLLM_BudgetTable
classes.description: Data class representing budget information for an organization or team.

classes.name: LiteLLM_OrganizationTable
classes.description: Data class representing an organization, including its current spend and budget details.

classes.name: LiteLLM_TeamTable
classes.description: Data class representing a team within an organization, including its spend and budget limits.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyAuth
classes.description: Authentication class carrying API token and associated organization/team info, including optional organization maximum budget.

methods.name: test_organization_budget_exceeded_blocks_request()
methods.description: Tests that requests from organizations exceeding max_budget are blocked with BudgetExceededError.

methods.name: test_multiple_teams_exceed_organization_budget()
methods.description: Verifies that the organization budget limit correctly enforces request failure even when individual teams are under budget.

methods.name: test_organization_budget_fields_are_checked()
methods.description: Ensures that organization_max_budget is populated and triggers enforcement when exceeded.

methods.name: test_both_team_and_org_budget_enforced()
methods.description: Checks that both team-level and organization-level budget constraints are enforced and cause errors when exceeded.
